answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure one identity per biological entity. By requiring non-deterministic human interaction, attackers cannot forge digital identities. Like sediment compressing into shale under immense pressure, the barrier to entry forces an attacker to cross a fiscal canyon of high capital expenditure to generate a sufficient volume of counterfeit nodes, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks economically non-viable for any rational participant.
